name: finstack
description: An operating system for investment thinking — one person + AI = a hedge fund's research department

scripts.build: bun build --compile engine/src/cli.ts --outfile engine/dist/finstack && git rev-parse HEAD > engine/dist/.version 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.lint: bunx biome check engine scripts test
scripts.lint:fix: bunx biome check --write engine scripts test
scripts.format: bunx biome format --write engine scripts test
scripts.test:gate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run check:docs
